hints.title: Prefix states
hints.body: Let `dp[i][j]` mean that the first `i` characters of `s` match the first `j` characters of `p`. Work from shorter prefixes to longer ones.

hints.title: Ordinary characters and dots
hints.body: If `p[j-1]` is not a star and matches `s[i-1]`, the state falls back to `dp[i-1][j-1]`.

hints.title: Handling a star
hints.body: A star can match zero copies, which corresponds to `dp[i][j-2]`. It can also match one more copy when the preceding pattern character matches the current string character, corresponding to `dp[i-1][j]`.
